summary: Suppose the place of g₁ is thick. The squared ratio relations of placeClass_ratio give ℓ^{2i} as a class of a ratio of thick places; for ℓ = 2 this contradicts the order of 4 modulo a power of 3, and for ℓ odd the three-term condition modulo 2^{s+1} forces ℓ^{2i} ≡ 1 mod 2^{s+1}, impossible for small i.

steps.claim: Suppose the place of complexEmbOf e g₁ is thick (u).
steps.lean:
.mk (complexEmbOf e g₁) ∉ D.thick := fun u ↦ by
  have A {g n m} h d c := congr($(placeClass_ratio e g g' a n h m d c) ^ 2)
  simp [mul_pow, ← Int.cast_pow, isUnit_sq, -map_pow] at A
  obtain rfl | o := hp.1.eq_two_or_odd'
  · grind [@orderOf_one_add_prime 3 out nofun _ ▸ orderOf_le_of_pow_eq_one hi (.trans (by norm_num
      [← mul_pow, sq]) ((A h₁ ⟨_, mul_left_comm ..⟩ (.pow _ _ rfl)).symm.trans
      (by simp [D.thick_eq_neg_one_mod, *]))), @Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self 3 out D.s]
  exact (@two_pow_le_of_pow_eq_one ℓ hp.1.one_lt (i * 2) _ (by lia) (by rw [Int.cast_natCast,
    pow_mul, ← A h₁ two_pow_dvd_N₁, ← map_div, D.three_term (2 * i) (2 * n) _ _ _ _ t'
    _ u _ t] <;> first | lia | simp [Units.ext_iff, pow_mul, A h, A h₁, o.pow] <;> ring)).not_gt
    (by grw [natAbs_natCast, hk, hn, hL]; use D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound)

steps.claim: Squared ratio relations: for each pair (g, n) as in placeClass_ratio, (class of the ratio)² = ℓ^{2n} modulo every admissible m (the signs square to 1).
steps.lean: have A {g n m} h d c := congr($(placeClass_ratio e g g' a n h m d c) ^ 2)

steps.claim: Simplified: squares of units, casts of powers.

steps.lean:
obtain rfl | o := hp.1.eq_two_or_odd'
  · grind [@orderOf_one_add_prime 3 out nofun _ ▸ orderOf_le_of_pow_eq_one hi (.trans (by norm_num
      [← mul_pow, sq]) ((A h₁ ⟨_, mul_left_comm ..⟩ (.pow _ _ rfl)).symm.trans
      (by simp [D.thick_eq_neg_one_mod, *]))), @Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self 3 out D.s]
  exact (@two_pow_le_of_pow_eq_one ℓ hp.1.one_lt (i * 2) _ (by lia) (by rw [Int.cast_natCast,
    pow_mul, ← A h₁ two_pow_dvd_N₁, ← map_div, D.three_term (2 * i) (2 * n) _ _ _ _ t'
    _ u _ t] <;> first | lia | simp [Units.ext_iff, pow_mul, A h, A h₁, o.pow] <;> ring)).not_gt
    (by grw [natAbs_natCast, hk, hn, hL]; use D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound)

steps.claim: ℓ = 2: modulo a power 3^K of 3 dividing N₁ (prime to 2^a), the thick places have class −1 (thick_eq_neg_one_mod), so the squared ratio relation for g' and g₁ gives 4^i ≡ 1 mod 3^K; the order of 4 = 1 + 3 modulo 3^K is 3^{K−1} (orderOf_one_add_prime), which is at most i < n ≤ 27s, contradicting 3^{log₃ s + 1} > s (lt_pow_succ_log_self) for the K used.
steps.lean:
· grind [@orderOf_one_add_prime 3 out nofun _ ▸ orderOf_le_of_pow_eq_one hi (.trans (by norm_num
      [← mul_pow, sq]) ((A h₁ ⟨_, mul_left_comm ..⟩ (.pow _ _ rfl)).symm.trans
      (by simp [D.thick_eq_neg_one_mod, *]))), @Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self 3 out D.s]

steps.claim: ℓ odd: modulo 2^{s+1} (which divides N₁, two_pow_dvd_N₁, and is coprime to ℓ^a) the three-term condition for the thick places g, g', g₁ with exponents 2i < 2n (three_term) gives ℓ^{2i} ≡ 1 mod 2^{s+1}, hence 2^s ≤ (ℓ + 1)·2i (two_pow_le_of_pow_eq_one); this contradicts ℓ ≤ kt, i < n ≤ 27s and the size of 2^s against k, t, s (nat_lt_of_hasLogBound).
steps.lean:
exact (@two_pow_le_of_pow_eq_one ℓ hp.1.one_lt (i * 2) _ (by lia) (by rw [Int.cast_natCast,
    pow_mul, ← A h₁ two_pow_dvd_N₁, ← map_div, D.three_term (2 * i) (2 * n) _ _ _ _ t'
    _ u _ t] <;> first | lia | simp [Units.ext_iff, pow_mul, A h, A h₁, o.pow] <;> ring)).not_gt
    (by grw [natAbs_natCast, hk, hn, hL]; use D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound)
